name: azurerm_subnet
description: Manages a subnet. Subnets represent network segments within the IP space defined by the virtual network.

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the subnet

virtual_network_name.name: virtual_network_name
virtual_network_name.description: The name of the virtual network to which to attach the subnet

address_prefixes.name: address_prefixes
address_prefixes.description: The address prefixes to use for the subnet

private_endpoint_network_policies_enable.name: private_endpoint_network_policies_enabled
private_endpoint_network_policies_enable.description: Enable or Disable network policies for the private endpoint on the subnet

private_link_service_network_policies_en.name: private_link_service_network_policies_enabled
private_link_service_network_policies_en.description: Enable or Disable network policies for the private link service on the subnet

service_endpoints.name: service_endpoints
service_endpoints.description: The list of Service endpoints to associate with the subnet (e.g., Microsoft.Storage, Microsoft.Sql)

service_endpoint_policy_ids.name: service_endpoint_policy_ids
service_endpoint_policy_ids.description: The list of IDs of Service Endpoint Policies to associate with the subnet
